notes.title: Update: More events added, new entrance fee system
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/3878cec88ba39a37b1705909f189119fd934673f.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello, community![/b][/h1]

Is there a point in apologizing for being silent if you won't forget us monsters anyway? Yeah, we think so too. Anyway, despite of how foul we are we are finally bringing you this substantial update. Details below:
[list][i][b]v.0.9.014.a[/b][/i]
[*] [u]New random (and crazy, of course) party events for you to handle.[/u] Talk about unexpected stuff.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/c2514dc3a980b537197db8bc6e1560b9b876a9e7.jpg[/img]

[*] [u]Entrance fee system was reworked and optimized.[/u] We have received a lot of the feedback from you guys about the old system being obscure and unintuitive at times. Now the bigger the price, the less people will come, simple as that. Easier to control your audience and to make profit at bigger locations.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/88d67638880df6f369f802275b662b1afedbaf1d.png[/img]

[*] [u]Party disappointment system underwent changes.[/u] We addressed a number of bugs and also made it more clear why partygoers were disappointed at times. In addition, a number of visitors who started to felt disappointed—and therefore left—was decreased.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/4135af88c5a572ebe195da065f30be73a1872c25.png[/img]

[*][u] Installed furniture icons now remain visible all the time.[/u] 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/3ee39966d527071806bb6914256ae56532934c4f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/adcdb1403e3c9ad3531abf39da8f7a2265d6d63b.png[/img][/url]
[*] [u]Table descriptions were simplified.[/u] Profit per person is now indicated clearly as well as capacity. Also, serving the table now costs 30% of its total value. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/a8be6a43dafe15adbb5d6d061624fa2ce6f3e6d4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/459c8bf4b2dc0b3070ca3369415d9c073fd78f1d.jpg[/img][/url]
[*] [u]Arcade cabinet was added as an early game green grade equipment.[/u] Gamer party theme now works better. Arcade cabinets don't need to be refilled. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/2c852c8b971c9df78ac07714bb6c61b6bb0f56d0.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/ddc80233f743796889992804a92b4af191da0cb7.png[/img][/url]
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] high grade characters unlocking on early stages on the game
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] toilets
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] janitors
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] quests based on the old [b]Hype[/b] system
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] calendar day modifiers based on the old [b]Hype[/b] system
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] fans not coming back when party is automated
[*] [u]Fixed[/u] [i]Party Hard 2[/i] keys being given away to first 3 people to leave the [b]"Bug 69"[/b] comment right under this announcement
[/list]
:partydisk:[b] Changes in progress for the next update:[/b]
[list]
[*] :partypolice: Detailed user manual on how things work in [i]Tycoon[/i]
[*] :partypills: Better high grade and modifiers balance
[*] :partymask: Characters and their cost balance
[*] :PartyEye: Story finale
[/list]
[b]Have fun![/b]:water:

notes.title: Update: AlienFX support added
notes.content:
[h1][b]What's up, community![/b][/h1]

We are here for the quick one: the game has received a minor, but, nevertheless, very important update.:partydisk:[i]Party Hard Tycoon[/i] is now a AlienFX-enabled game that has an integrated lighting effect support. That means [b]Alienware[/b] users now can adjust their game to have a better pixel-driven experience.

[b]Have fun, everyone![/b]:water:

tags.feature: - [i]Party Hard Tycoon[/i] is now a AlienFX-enabled game that has an integrated lighting effect support.

notes.title: Update: Guest requirement mods, New events, Auto-party, and more
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/7cab8b9ff14533ea1411f73d3af88a4d40637cc6.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello, everyone![/b][/h1]

[b]Yes, we admit, it took us too long to finally fulfill our promise. And we know there are no forgiveness for our sins.[/b] Try to accept our sincere apologies for the delay and believe us: reasons for this were pretty valid. Now, enough taking your time away, let's summarize new features [i]Party Hard Tycoon[/i] has aquired:
[olist]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/702207d66f7f6c3ad045ea9a15d4b9938eaf59fa.jpg[/img]
    [*][b][above][/b] [b]Auto-party.[/b] You can automatically re-throw your party to repeat the success and organize another party at the same time. This option is available [b]IF[/b] the following requirements are met: 
- you haven't changed your trade, equipment and decor items at a certain venue
- you haven't changed the theme of the party
- your party was successful
---------------------------------------------------------------
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/654c15c3a26e9629d16f3383dc2e58ebc16e4116.gif[/img]
    [*][b][above][/b] [b]Restrooms.[/b] People drink and eat stuff at your parties, therefore they need to go sometimes. Be sure your guests have access to toilets at all times. Or... see above.
---------------------------------------------------------------
    [*][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/fa28b8ff2a6ff0a3ea443014cda1ee3ae4471b27.jpg[/img]
[b][above][/b] [b]Game over screen.[/b] Now redesigned. You are given a rank every time you fail. Rank shown in the screenshot above means you did not do very well...
---------------------------------------------------------------
    [*][b]Smoking areas.[/b] Create designated smoking area at your party to avoid complaints from non-smokers.
---------------------------------------------------------------
    [*][b]Littering.[/b] Guests leave trash. Clean the place to avoid complaints from... pretty much everyone.
---------------------------------------------------------------
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e710d99e56d3b1a5ba7727b00275d96233788d87.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/7738477085b3ebeddbb0401aff174965c358d06e.jpg[/img]
    [*][b][above][/b] [b]More accurate requirements and mods.[/b] Green icons indicate guests' expectations, red icons indicate undesirable circumstances.
---------------------------------------------------------------
    [*][b]Music.[/b] It has a bigger impact on your guests. Different equipment will cause different effects that will or won't be suitable for a given party theme.
---------------------------------------------------------------
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/76c2e86a96110bc52f625ce985969e0930a7ac80.jpg[/img]
    [*][b][above][/b] [b]Updated events.[/b] Random party events are more interactive now. Their effects (positive or negative) depends on your decision. 
[/olist]
The update is still somewhat raw, so do not hesitate to report all kinds of issues here, on this community's forums, or via the in-game main menu interface. The game is still in early access state, so there will be more updates and fixes in the future. 

 [b]Have fun, partygoers![/b]:water::partydisk:

notes.title: Huge update coming soon
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e11d90a0f0e13ae37289d355fb9d0e33ab9581d9.gif[/img]

Hello, [b]PH community[/b]!

We are assembling a huge [i]Party Hard Tycoon[/i] update for you at present. And cannot help but toss a few spoilers your way. Luckily, these are the kind of spoilers you are not ruthlessly brutalized for. So, let's dance:
[list]
    [*]In general, people will be more precise in expressing their preferences at parties. 

    [*][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/47089979d9505eae48821005cd6b14aad01eaa32.gif[/img]
[b][above][/b] Toilet rooms will have a purpose. Except for essential processes in all forms of life, these rooms might be providing a base for other acts. Yuck, smells like smoke!
    [*][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/560a7f5208ef9ea1c7927a04dfa7f20aa8e023e8.gif[/img]
[b][above][/b] You will be able to designate a space of your choice as a smoking area, so noone wines about how bad the smoke smells. [u](Beware: smoking is harmful to your [strike]wallet[/strike] health)[/u]
    [*][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/66f98c735ed4acf907d4ac7ccc740b5ed4630b5a.gif[/img]
[b][above][/b] We will add [u]trash[/u] that will have to be cleaned up, by you. Why? Because humans are naturally disgusted by garbage and, therefore, will be disappointed by your event. Some people will litter more than others, naturally. Pigs.
    [*][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e710d99e56d3b1a5ba7727b00275d96233788d87.png[/img]
[b][above][/b] Each theme will get more accurate requirements. Icons shown in the screenshot above will indicate your visitors' expectations. Green for what they expect, red—for... Cmon, you can see that. Beer for hangover prelude, [i]Cristal[/i] for fancy galas, in short.
    [*]Music will have a bigger impact. A speaker, a piano or a DJ controller will cause different effects that will or will not be suitable for a given party theme.
    [*]BBQ and campfiring away indoors will not be a good idea anymore. 
    [*]We have received lots of feedback concerning random events that occur during parties. We listened and now plan to add more of them, but with more player involvement and various gameplay mechanics. You'll have to decide whether to bribe a cop or not, is it a clever idea to let a baseball bat-wielding muscle in, or should your guests try the brand new milk/orange cocktail. 
[/list]
Well, that about sums it up for now. Please, tell us what you think, guys, as we're always heartily open for the feedback and any incoming suggestions. See you at the party!

P.S. Below is what you deal with when the toilet room is occupied:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/654c15c3a26e9629d16f3383dc2e58ebc16e4116.gif[/img]

notes.title: Lenient nerfing, Cyrillic speech bubbles gone and other changes
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy, skilful party throwers![/h1]

Meet another [i]Party Hard Tycoon[/i] update. We have fixed some bugs and made changes to the gameplay. Here goes the full change log:
[list]
    [*]items' [b]electricity/hype/durability[/b] icons have returned to the pre-party planning phase:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/ddc782cbfd66a29fdc34010a4d845ab30d4504d4.png[/img]
    [*]fixed [b]quest/dialogue[/b] window issues
    [*]fixed the bug with [b]quests[/b] not completing properly
    [*]fixed [b]likes/dislikes[/b] issues
    [*]fixed the [b]lights[/b] that blocked passages
    [*]fixed [b]Cyrillic sреесн виввles[/b] popping up in the English version
    [*]fixed the [b]Game over[/b] screen
    [*]fixed [b]personnel[/b] cursor
    [*]made the [b]afterparty statistics[/b] plausible
    [*]bossted chances to get [b]likes[/b] during parties
    [*]nerfed chances for people to be [b]disappointed[/b]
[/list]
There you go. That's all the changes for today, friends. Have fun and don't hesitate to ask us "Where's music?"—we're always here for you. ːpartydiskːːpartylipsː

notes.title: Big Update and Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

We have just updated Party Hard Tycoon and here is a short list of major changes:
[list]
 [*][b]Redesigned calendar system[/b] 
Colors of days were too confusing for some players, so we rebuilt this system from scratch. Now venues are not locked to certain calendar days. You still control time progression with it and can see some days with events.

In the next update we will introduce new mechanics regarding locations. We think it will work with the new system just perfectly. We hope it will add more depth to the location management. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/d3f0a0e7012f298fe65f8c72bf2bf8370eb885e7.png[/img]
 
[*][b]Pre-party[/b] 
Now you can refill your tables with drinks and food before the party. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e10085a8cb349eeba10831cdbb53d16ce7762232.gif[/img]

 [*][b]Table refill[/b] 
We increased waiter refill speed greatly. Also, now he tends to walk only near the tables and doesn`t wander the venue aimlessly.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/0793912fc5a2ebffae7a14b26e8789f8d5c04053.gif[/img]
 
[*][b]People AI[/b] 
Now party goers will look for fun instead of checking the fun level on their current spot. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/7f9c32c9773ee9765ed11141d2d118977d53a6ad.png[/img]
 
[*][b]Interface redesign and fixes[/b] 

 [*][b]Achievements[/b] 
This patch should finally fix all major achievement issues. Please,  report if you still have some problems. 
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming changes[/h1]
Thanks for your feedback, we are preparing really big changes to the game. They will influence all aspects of the game. Expect new, deeper strategy mechanics, redesigned party goer AI and absolutely new purpose of decor. The new update will come shortly. Please,  let us know if you have some ideas you would like to see realized in future updates, we are checking them all!

notes.title: Big Update and Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
Hey, folks! 

We have just updated Party Hard Tycoon and here is a short list of major changes:
[list]
 [*][b]Redesigned calendar system[/b] 
Colors of days were too confusing for some players, so we rebuilt this system from scratch. Now venues are not locked to certain calendar days. You still control time progression with it and can see some days with events.

In the next update we will introduce new mechanics regarding locations. We think it will work with the new system just perfectly. We hope it will add more depth to the location management. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/d3f0a0e7012f298fe65f8c72bf2bf8370eb885e7.png[/img]
 
[*][b]Pre-party[/b] 
Now you can refill your tables with drinks and food before the party. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e10085a8cb349eeba10831cdbb53d16ce7762232.gif[/img]

 [*][b]Table refill[/b] 
We increased waiter refill speed greatly. Also, now he tends to walk only near the tables and doesn`t wander the venue aimlessly.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/0793912fc5a2ebffae7a14b26e8789f8d5c04053.gif[/img]
 
[*][b]People AI[/b] 
Now party goers will look for fun instead of checking the fun level on their current spot. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/7f9c32c9773ee9765ed11141d2d118977d53a6ad.png[/img]
 
[*][b]Interface redesign and fixes[/b] 

 [*][b]Achievements[/b] 
This patch should finally fix all major achievement issues. Please,  report if you still have some problems. 
[/list]
[h1]Upcoming changes[/h1]
Thanks for your feedback, we are preparing really big changes to the game. They will influence all aspects of the game. Expect new, deeper strategy mechanics, redesigned party goer AI and absolutely new purpose of decor. The new update will come shortly. Please,  let us know if you have some ideas you would like to see realized in future updates, we are checking them all!

notes.title: Hotfix Day 2, Party Hard Killer!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/b536d1a38c268f1f1adaca29b41a47f669f269fe.gif[/img]
[h1][b]What is up, peeps![/b][/h1]

Worked hard to deliver this hot batch of fixes and new features. There goes the change log (EDITED):
[list]
    [*]we fixed achievements not unlocking
    [*]we [b]fully[/b] fixed the bug when people complained about the lack of music standing in a room full of speakers
    [*]we fixed the lights efficiency not displaying properly
    [*]we [b]partially[/b] fixed localization 
    [*]we got rid of some resolution problems and added ultrawide 3440x1440 resolution
    [*]we added gameplay hints
    [*]we added the possibility to see lights & speakers' effect areas during party:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/6bb572b0f487f1b50f496d5179b284379e828be5.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Darius is here![/h1] ːpartyknifeː

Expected him, didn't you? Yes, he is here and loud parties still drive this fellow nuts. To meet him, you have to be on the lookout for the [i]Thrower of the Month: Worst Party[/i] contest results. [spoiler]Tip: you can win it by getting the most dislikes. Sounds easy, right? ;-)[/spoiler]

[h1]Happy partying, y'all![/h1]

notes.title: Party Hard Tycoon character reveal, a lot of news coming soon
notes.content:
[h1]What's going on, party giants! [/h1] ːpartypillsː

Long time no see, people. We admit: you haven't heard from us for quite some time. But don't be mad - we will deliver. Starting now!

[u][b] Meet Rosty[/b][/u]

First thing's first: game's just got better. Cause it was joined by one and only [b] Rosty the Roisterer[/b]!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/6ce9d6ecda7ec2dcdc7080a655dcd684efed0367.jpg[/img]

Never heard of the man? Believe me, you will. This guy right here is one of the most ferocious party goers in the world! 

[u] [b] Expect news soon [/b][/u]

Our buddy Double R went social for a reason. There will be huge [i] Party Hard Tycoon [/i] activity soon, so Rosty wants you to stay on top of things. For hot [i] Party [/i] news don't forget to check our Steam community page on a damn regular basis: got some grand new-s-tuff in store for ya. 

[b] Happy partying, faulks![/b] ːwaterː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/4b3e78c4f54c6a802d7886315bfa9c59c28bf30d.gif[/img]
